 Gurvinder Singh Gill, J.(Oral)

1. The petitioner seeks quashing of Fir No. 302, dated 26.10.2023, Police Station Rama Mandi,
Police Commissionerate Jalandhar, District Jalandhar, under Sections 201, 406, 420, 465, 467, 468,
471, 120-B Ipc and Section 13 of Punjab Travel Professionals (Regulation) Act, 2014.

2.  The allegations, in nutshell, are that the complainant has been defrauded of an amount of Rs.23.5 lakhs, out of which an amount of Rs.50,000/- is stated to have been collected by the petitioner who is wife of Davinder Singh.
3. Learned counsel submits that the petitioner who is wife of co-accused Davinder Singh has been roped in simply in order to pressurize Davinder Singh as is somehow a trend in the current times.
4. Notice of motion.

sentences.text: At this stage, Mr. Gauravdeep Singh Dhaliwal, AAG, Punjab, who is present in the Court accepts notice.
Learned State counsel, upon instructions from ASI Bhajan Ram has informed that the matter is still under investigation.
6. Upon perusal of the FIR, this Court does find that a very passive role has been attributed to the petitioner who is wife of main accused Davinder Singh.
It is a very small amount and that too in cash which is stated to have been collected by the petitioner by going to the house of the complainant.

Under these circumstances, the Commissioner of Police, District Jalandhar is directed to ensure that the allegations qua the petitioner are scrutinized minutely before presentation of challan and to ensure that innocent people are not harassed at the instance of unscrupluous complaints unnecessarily, as is somehow observed in several cases wherein close relatives of the main accused,
particularly the ladies are nominated in the FIR to pressurise the entire family of accused.
7.
The petition stands disposed of accordingly.
